dedicated.name: Randgrid's Wound-Covering Eyepatch

why_by_stat.Crush: Mainly useful in PVP. Reduces the enemy’s Block Rate 1%-for-1%, making it easier for Randgrid to land Critical Hits and deal more damage to tanky enemies.
why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Randgrid by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"Tsk-tsk — will you cut that out? The way you keep fidgeting with your hands is distracting."

Haunted by guilt after accidentally injuring Radgrid's eye during a sparring match, Randgrid gave up one of her own eyes to be transplanted to her sister. Then, with her wounded eye concealed under an eyepatch, she subsequently stepped into the role of family successor. Though hailed as the "Undefeated Valkyrie" on the battlefield, she still has the nervous habit of fidgeting with her eyepatch in her father's presence. Yet, aware that she can no longer afford to falter, she steels herself for the sake of her and her sister's future, confidently speaking out against her father's stubborn resistance as the rightful heir to the family.

lore:
Born as the eldest daughter of a prestigious noble family with a long lineage of Celestial Generals, Randgrid possesses a combination of integrity, leadership, and exceptional martial arts skills.
After defeating her younger sister Radgrid in a battle over the right of succession, Randgrid became the family heir. However, she felt a great sense of guilt over taking the title while her sister was left with lasting injuries, and because of this, she was hesitating to accept the position of Celestial Guardian proposed by Radgrid. It was then that Freyja approached her. Under the pretext of lending her power to help Radgrid, Freyja entrusted Randgrid with the task of controlling Mist. However, this was actually part of Freyja's plan to ensure the success of the experiment on Mist.
